title: Dream Days
summary: "Dream Days" by Kenneth Grahame is a collection of children's fiction and childhood reminiscences published in 1898. A sequel to "The Golden Age," it follows the same family of five children through stories that portray an unsentimental view of childhood, where adults remain completely disconnected from young people's true concerns, griefs, and passions. The collection is best remembered for including Grahame's beloved classic tale "The Reluctant Dragon," though all eight selections offer glimpses into the vivid inner world of youth.
